meta.audience: children three to six and their parents
meta.title: 비 오는 날의 밤톨이
meta.reviewed: Written by hand from source/BRIEF.md (비 오는 날의 밤톨이, a watercolour picture book about a little hedgehog who shares his leaf umbrella (fictional book)). Every decision below follows the brief and the style it names; nothing is a preset.

source.notes: 비 오는 날의 밤톨이, a watercolour picture book about a little hedgehog who shares his leaf umbrella (fictional book)
Korean OFL fonts, cut to the characters the reel shows

rationale.palette: Cream paper #FBF6EC under everything; a grey-blue rainy sky and rain #7E9DB5; soft greens for hills and grass; a chestnut hedgehog #8B5A3C with a cream face; a pale lilac-grey bunny with pink ears; a leaf green #6BA34A; a rainbow at the end; brown brush-pen ink #4A3426.
rationale.type: Hi Melody, a soft handwritten face, for the story lines, set with a little bleed; Gowun Dodum for the small print.
rationale.motion: Acting first: the hedgehog waddles, squashes when a drop hits his nose, blinks and looks up, crouches before he pulls the leaf (anticipation) and springs up with it; the bunny shivers on twos, her ears droop and then spring up when the leaf covers her; both hop into the puddle with squash on landing; paint blooms in from a point; shapes boil slightly on twos.
rationale.sound: Corporate at 96 BPM in G major on recorded instruments (VSCO 2 CE and VCSL, CC0): a soft violin bed, harp in broken eighths, a flute hook, cello pizzicato bass and a light shaker; a violin pizzicato for every raindrop on the leaf, a harp arpeggio as the title blooms, low pizzicato chords for the puddle hops.
rationale.visuals: All code: washes are wobbly closed shapes in two uneven layers with a darker pigment edge and paper grain multiplied inside; lines are a brush pen; the landscape is painted once per weather and cached; paper grain is multiplied over the finished frame; characters are rigs posed from keyframes with breathing, blinking and a walk cycle on top.
rationale.narration: Possible: a warm voice reading the two lines, but the reel works without it.
